title: चतुस्त्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: The Pandavas cannot break Drona's array, and Yudhishthira tells Abhimanyu to break in since Arjuna is away. Abhimanyu says he knows how to enter but not how to come out, and Bhima promises to follow him in.
summary.kn: ಪಾಂಡವರು ದ್ರೋಣನ ವ್ಯೂಹ ಭೇದಿಸಲಾಗದಿದ್ದಾಗ ಅರ್ಜುನ ದೂರವಿರುವುದರಿಂದ ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಅಭಿಮನ್ಯುವಿಗೆ ಒಳನುಗ್ಗಲು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಒಳಗೆ ಹೋಗುವುದು ಗೊತ್ತು, ಹೊರಬರುವುದು ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು ಅಭಿಮನ್ಯು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಭೀಮ ಅವನನ್ನು ಹಿಂಬಾಲಿಸುವೆನೆನ್ನುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: पाण्डव द्रोण का व्यूह नहीं तोड़ पाते, तब अर्जुन के दूर होने से युधिष्ठिर अभिमन्यु से घुसने को कहते हैं। अभिमन्यु कहता है कि वह घुसना जानता है पर निकलना नहीं, और भीम पीछे आने का वचन देते हैं।
summary.te: పాండవులు ద్రోణుని వ్యూహాన్ని ఛేదించలేకపోగా అర్జునుడు దూరంగా ఉండటంతో యుధిష్ఠిరుడు అభిమన్యుని లోపలికి దూసుకెళ్లమంటాడు. లోపలికి వెళ్లడం తెలుసు కానీ బయటకు రావడం తెలియదని అభిమన్యుడు అంటాడు; భీముడు అతని వెనుక వస్తానంటాడు.
summary.ta: பாண்டவரால் த்ரோணரின் வியூகத்தை உடைக்க இயலாமல், அர்ஜுனன் தொலைவில் இருப்பதால் உள்ளே நுழையுமாறு யுதிஷ்டிரர் அபிமன்யுவிடம் கூறுகிறார். உள்ளே செல்லத் தெரியும், வெளியே வரத் தெரியாது என்று அபிமன்யு கூற, பீமன் பின்தொடர்வதாக உறுதியளிக்கிறான்.
summary.ml: ദ്രോണരുടെ വ്യൂഹം ഭേദിക്കാൻ പാണ്ഡവർക്കാകുന്നില്ല; അർജുനൻ അകലെയായതിനാൽ അഭിമന്യു അത് ഭേദിക്കണമെന്ന് യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ പറയുന്നു. വ്യൂഹത്തിൽ കടക്കാൻ അറിയാമെന്നും പുറത്തുകടക്കാൻ അറിയില്ലെന്നും അഭിമന്യു പറയുന്നു; പിന്നാലെ കടക്കുമെന്ന് ഭീമൻ വാഗ്ദാനം ചെയ്യുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.34; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
तदनीकमनाधृष्यं भारद्वाजेन रक्षितम् ।
पार्थाः समभ्यवर्तन्त भीमसेनपुरोगमाः ॥

meaning.en: The Parthas, led by Bhimasena, advanced against that unassailable army guarded by Bharadvaja's son.

verses.text:
सात्यकिश्चेकितानश्च धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः ।
कुन्तिभोजश्च विक्रान्तो द्रुपदश्च महारथः ॥

meaning.en: Satyaki, Chekitana, Dhrishtadyumna son of Prishata, the valiant Kuntibhoja, and the great chariot-warrior Drupada,

verses.text:
आर्जुनिः क्षत्रधर्मा च बृहत्क्षत्रश्च वीर्यवान् ।
चेदिपो धृष्टकेतुश्च माद्रीपुत्रौ घटोत्कचः ॥

meaning.en: Arjuna's son Abhimanyu, Kshatradharman, the mighty Brihatkshatra, Dhrishtaketu the Chedi, the two sons of Madri, Ghatotkacha,

verses.text:
युधामन्युश्च विक्रान्तः शिखण्डी चापराजितः ।
उत्तमौजाश्च दुर्धर्षो विराटश्च महारथः ॥

meaning.en: the valiant Yudhamanyu, the unconquered Shikhandi, the unassailable Uttamauja, and the great chariot-warrior Virata,

verses.text:
द्रौपदेयाश्च संरब्धाः शैशुपालिश्च वीर्यवान् ।
केकयाश्च महावीर्याः सृञ्जयाश्च सहस्रशः ॥

meaning.en: Draupadi's sons in fury, the mighty son of Shishupala, the very powerful Kekayas and thousands of Srinjayas,

verses.text:
एते चान्ये च सगणाः कृतास्त्रा युद्धदुर्मदाः ।
समभ्यधावन्सहसा भारद्वाजं युयुत्सवः ॥

meaning.en: these and others with their troops, skilled in weapons and mad for battle, suddenly rushed at Bharadvaja's son, eager to fight.

verses.text:
समवेतांस्तु तान्सर्वान्भारद्वाजोऽपि वीर्यवान् ।
असंभ्रान्तः शरौघेण महता समवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: Though they were all gathered together, Bharadvaja's son, mighty and unshaken, held them back with a great flood of arrows.

verses.text:
महौघाः सलिलस्येव गिरिमासाद्य दुर्भिदम् ।
द्रोणं ते नाभ्यवर्तन्त वेलामिव जलाशयाः ॥

meaning.en: As great floods of water do not cross a hard-to-split mountain, they could not go past Drona, like water bodies unable to cross their shore.

verses.text:
पीड्यमानाः शरै राजन्द्रोणचापविनिःसृतैः ।
न शेकुः प्रमुखे स्थातुं भारद्वाजस्य पाण्डवाः ॥

meaning.en: Tormented, O king, by arrows shot from Drona's bow, the Pandavas could not stand before Bharadvaja's son.

verses.text:
तदद्भुतमपश्याम द्रोणस्य भुजयोर्बलम् ।
यदेनं नाभ्यवर्तन्त पाञ्चालाः सृञ्जयैः सह ॥

meaning.en: We saw that marvel, the strength of Drona's arms, that the Panchalas with the Srinjayas could not advance against him.

verses.text:
तमायान्तमभिक्रुद्धं द्रोणं दृष्ट्वा युधिष्ठिरः ।
बहुधा चिन्तयामास द्रोणस्य प्रतिवारणम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Drona advance in fury, Yudhishthira thought in many ways about how to stop him.

verses.text:
अशक्यं तु तमन्येन द्रोणं मत्वा युधिष्ठिरः ।
अविषह्यं गुरुं भारं सौभद्रे समवासृजत् ॥

meaning.en: Thinking no one else could do it, Yudhishthira placed that unbearable, heavy burden on Subhadra's son.

verses.text:
वासुदेवादनवरं फल्गुनाच्चामितौजसम् ।
अब्रवीत्परवीरघ्नमभिमन्युमिदं वचः ॥

meaning.en: Abhimanyu, no less than Vasudeva and of boundless strength like Phalguna, slayer of enemy heroes, he addressed with these words.

verses.text:
एत्य नो नार्जुनो गर्हेद्यथा तात तथा कुरु ।
चक्रव्यूहस्य न वयं विद्म भेदं कथंचन ॥

meaning.en: "Do as you will, dear boy, so that Arjuna, when he returns, does not blame us; we do not know how to break the wheel array."

verses.text:
त्वं वार्जुनो वा कृष्णो वा भिन्द्यात्प्रद्युम्न एव वा ।
चक्रव्यूहं महाबाहो पञ्चमोऽन्यो न विद्यते ॥

meaning.en: "You, or Arjuna, or Krishna, or Pradyumna could break the wheel array, mighty-armed one; there is no fifth."

verses.text:
अभिमन्यो वरं तात याचतां दातुमर्हसि ।
पितॄणां मातुलानां च सैन्यानां चैव सर्वशः ॥

meaning.en: "Abhimanyu, dear boy, you should grant a boon to those who ask: to your fathers, your uncles and all the armies."

verses.text:
धनंजयो हि नस्तात गर्हयेदेत्य संयुगात् ।
क्षिप्रमस्त्रं समादाय द्रोणानीकं विशातय ॥

meaning.en: "For Dhananjaya will blame us when he comes back from the battle. Quickly take up your weapon and tear Drona's division apart."

verses.text: अभिमन्युरुवाच

meaning.en: Abhimanyu said:

verses.text:
द्रोणस्य दृढमव्यग्रमनीकप्रवरं युधि ।
पितॄणां जयमाकाङ्क्षन्नवगाहे भिनद्मि च ॥

meaning.en: "Desiring victory for my fathers, I will plunge into and break Drona's firm and steady, best of divisions."

verses.text:
उपदिष्टो हि मे पित्रा योगोऽनीकस्य भेदने ।
नोत्सहे तु विनिर्गन्तुमहं कस्यांचिदापदि ॥

meaning.en: "For my father taught me the way to break into an array; but in any danger I would not be able to come out."

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
भिन्ध्यनीकं युधा श्रेष्ठ द्वारं संजनयस्व नः ।
वयं त्वानुगमिष्यामो येन त्वं तात यास्यसि ॥

meaning.en: "Break the division, best of fighters, and make us a gate; we will follow you wherever you go, dear boy."

verses.text:
धनंजयसमं युद्धे त्वां वयं तात संयुगे ।
प्रणिधायानुयास्यामो रक्षन्तः सर्वतोमुखाः ॥

meaning.en: "We shall follow you, dear boy, in the battle as we would Dhananjaya, guarding you from every side."

verses.text: भीम उवाच

meaning.en: Bhima said:

verses.text:
अहं त्वानुगमिष्यामि धृष्टद्युम्नोऽथ सात्यकिः ।
पाञ्चालाः केकया मत्स्यास्तथा सर्वे प्रभद्रकाः ॥

meaning.en: "I will follow you, and Dhrishtadyumna and Satyaki, the Panchalas, Kekayas, Matsyas and all the Prabhadrakas."

verses.text:
सकृद्भिन्नं त्वया व्यूहं तत्र तत्र पुनः पुनः ।
वयं प्रध्वंसयिष्यामो निघ्नमाना वरान्वरान् ॥

meaning.en: "Once you have broken the array, we shall break it down again and again at each place, killing the best of their men."

verses.text: अभिमन्युरुवाच

meaning.en: Abhimanyu said:

verses.text:
अहमेतत्प्रवेक्ष्यामि द्रोणानीकं दुरासदम् ।
पतंग इव संक्रुद्धो ज्वलितं जातवेदसम् ॥

meaning.en: "I will enter that unassailable division of Drona, like an angry moth into a blazing fire."

verses.text:
तत्कर्माद्य करिष्यामि हितं यद्वंशयोर्द्वयोः ।
मातुलस्य च या प्रीतिर्भविष्यति पितुश्च मे ॥

meaning.en: "Today I will do that deed which benefits both my families and which will please my uncle and my father."

verses.text:
शिशुनैकेन संग्रामे काल्यमानानि संघशः ।
अद्य द्रक्ष्यन्ति भूतानि द्विषत्सैन्यानि वै मया ॥

meaning.en: "Today all beings will see enemy armies driven in masses by one child in battle, by me."

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
एवं ते भाषमाणस्य बलं सौभद्र वर्धताम् ।
यस्त्वमुत्सहसे भेत्तुं द्रोणानीकं सुदुर्भिदम् ॥

meaning.en: "As you speak so, Subhadra's son, may your strength grow, you who are ready to break Drona's very hard to break division,"

verses.text:
रक्षितं पुरुषव्याघ्रैर्महेष्वासैः प्रहारिभिः ।
साध्यरुद्रमरुत्कल्पैर्वस्वग्न्यादित्यविक्रमैः ॥

meaning.en: "guarded by tigers among men, great archers and strikers, equal to Sadhyas, Rudras and Maruts, with the valor of Vasus, Agni and Adityas."

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा स यन्तारमचोदयत् ।
सुमित्राश्वान्रणे क्षिप्रं द्रोणानीकाय चोदय ॥

meaning.en: Hearing his words, Abhimanyu urged his charioteer: "Sumitra, quickly drive the horses to Drona's division in the battle."
